name: @mm/server
description: The authoritative multiplayer server: match lifecycle, the canonical ordered action batch, the snapshot wire format, and desync detection via the snapshot hash — contracts.md §5 and §8.
author: Ann Kelner
//: contracts.md §5 grants this package one edge, to @mm/agent-api, and that is the whole dependency list — the same shape mc-harness has. It drives AgentSession and never reaches past it into sim-core, which is why adding it needed no new §5 deviation. It has zero third-party runtime dependencies deliberately: this is the package the AGPL network clause bears on most directly, and a source offer a stranger can act on is one whose transport is Node's own net module rather than a dependency tree. It is host-side — it owns sockets and reads a wall clock for tick pacing, which §8 makes the server's job — but the wall clock is confined to src/clock.ts and never reaches a rules computation. Nothing in this workspace imports it: §5 rule 2.
